info.title: necodoc API
info.description: Render HTML to PDF, generate from published templates (singly or in batches), and combine PDFs. Authenticate with an API key in the `x-api-key` header. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Published templates, their schemas, and generating from them.

tags.name: Generations
tags.description: Entries in the generation log, and their PDFs.

downloadUrl.description: Signed; works without a key for 1 hour.

pdfUrl.description: Signed; works without a key for 1 hour.

docusign.description: DocuSign eSignature v2.1 envelope definition: POST it to /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{accountId}/envelopes.

formats.description: Provider JSON, as asked for in `formats`.

SigningPackage.description: The PDF's signers and sign boxes, for an e-sign provider.

Signer.description: A signer, with name and email rendered from the data.

rect.description: PDF points in the page's user space, origin bottom-left (what pdf-lib uses).

topLeft.description: Points (pixels at 72 dpi) from the top-left of the page as displayed (DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, Adobe Sign).

normalized.description: Fractions (0..1) of the displayed page, origin top-left.

anchorString.description: Invisible text at the box's top-left corner, for anchor-based tab placement. Null when the PDF has none.

response.description: `pdf` returns the bytes; `json` returns the generation and a link.

async.description: Answer 202 with the generation id at once instead of waiting.

subject.description: Who the document is about (an email, a customer number), for erasure.

RenderRequest.description: HTML (Liquid allowed) to render as a PDF.

pdfa.description: PDF/A-2 level (`2b` or `2u`), or null for none.

pdfua.description: Tagged PDF/UA-1. HTML renders only: overlays and packets have no structure to tag.

certify.description: Certify with the server's certificate (PAdES, DocMDP: form filling and signing stay allowed).

lang.description: The document language (BCP 47): date, number and currency formatting, translations, text direction, and the PDF language.

OutputOptions.description: PDF/A, PDF/UA, certification and the document language.

Translations.description: Per language, source text to its translation: `{ "fr": { "Invoice": "Facture" } }`.

anchors.description: Keep the invisible anchor text in the PDF. `false` costs one more Chromium pass.

embedPdf.description: Put the PDF in provider JSON as base64 (DocuSign `documentBase64`).

placement.description: DocuSign tabs by page coordinates, or by anchor string.

SigningOptions.description: Answer with a signing package (JSON) instead of the PDF. `true`: DocuSign JSON, anchors kept, PDF embedded.

post.description: HTML with Liquid (rendered with `data`), optional CSS, theme, header and footer bands, and page setup. `output.lang` is the document language: `date`, `number` and `currency` format for it, `t` looks text up in `translations`, and right-to-left languages lay out right to left. Logged in the generation log with source `api`.

200.description: Rendered. `response: pdf` (default) returns the bytes; `response: json` returns the generation. With `signing`, the signing package.

202.description: Still queued or running (async, or the wait ran out). Poll the generation.

403.description: The key lacks the scope, role, template or source address this call needs.

422.description: Invalid request or data; `fieldErrors` lists each.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the key may call again.

post.summary: Generate a PDF from a template
post.description: Validates `data` against the version's fields (422 with every field error), then renders it. `output.lang` makes the PDF in another language than the template's: formatting, the template's translations and text direction follow it.
